name: glucosylceramidase beta 1

function.text: GBA1 encodes lysosomal acid glucosylceramidase. Annotated molecular activities include beta-glucosidase activity and galactosylceramidase activity. It participates in termination of signal transduction and autophagy.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Gaucher disease (autosomal recessive); Parkinson disease (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
